raw_text:
{
  "scenario": "schelling",
  "phenomenon": "segregation",
  "indicators": [
    {
      "id": "micro_mean_local_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Mean local same-group similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the average across agents of each agent's same-group fraction among occupied Moore neighbours.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "individual",
      "entities": "individual agents",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "mean",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Local similarity is an individual-level primitive measuring each agent's immediate social environment."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_std_local_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Std of local same-group similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the standard deviation across agents of local same-group similarity, capturing variability in individual local exposure.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "individual",
      "entities": "individual agents",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "std",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Between-individual variation in local context is an individual-level primitive that can reveal uneven segregation pressure."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_median_local_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Median local same-group similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the median across agents of local same-group similarity, providing a robust individual-level central tendency.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "individual",
      "entities": "individual agents",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "quantile",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
        "axis": "agent",
        "q": 0.5
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "The median local similarity summarises the typical individual neighbourhood experience without assuming a normal distribution."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_frac_unhappy",
      "semantic_name": "Fraction of unsatisfied agents",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the fraction of agents whose local same-group similarity is below tolerance, recorded by the unhappy primitive.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "individual dissatisfaction events",
      "source_fields": ["unhappy"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "fraction",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "parameter_associations": [
        {
          "parameter": "tolerance",
          "relationship": "direct",
          "expected_indicator_direction": "increase",
          "rationale": "Higher tolerance raises the minimum local similarity required for satisfaction, so more agents fall below the threshold and become unhappy."
        }
      ],
      "scientific_rationale": "The unhappy field is a primitive dissatisfaction event recording whether local similarity is below tolerance, and its prevalence is a micro-level observable."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_count_unhappy",
      "semantic_name": "Count of unsatisfied agents",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the number of agents with unhappy true, recomputed from individual dissatisfaction events.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "individual dissatisfaction events",
      "source_fields": ["unhappy"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "count",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Aggregate count of individual dissatisfaction events preserved as a micro time series for comparison with system log aggregates."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_mean_neighbour_count",
      "semantic_name": "Mean occupied neighbour count",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the average across agents of the number of occupied Moore neighbours.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "individual",
      "entities": "individual agents",
      "source_fields": ["neighbour_count"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "mean",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "neighbour_count"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Neighbour count is an individual-level local occupancy primitive that affects the information an agent has about its surroundings."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_frac_boundary_agents",
      "semantic_name": "Fraction of boundary agents",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the fraction of agents that have at least one occupied different-group neighbour.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "interaction",
      "entities": "agents with different-group neighbours",
      "source_fields": ["boundary_agent"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "fraction",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "boundary_agent"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Boundary exposure is a binary individual-level interaction primitive that marks local contact between groups."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_frac_moved",
      "semantic_name": "Fraction of agents that relocated",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the fraction of agents that relocated during each recorded step.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "individual relocation events",
      "source_fields": ["moved"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "fraction",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "moved"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "The moved field is a primitive relocation event; its prevalence captures the overall micro-level relocation activity."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_frac_moved_among_unhappy",
      "semantic_name": "Fraction of unsatisfied agents that moved",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the proportion of unhappy agents that relocated during each step.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "unhappy agents that attempted relocation",
      "source_fields": ["unhappy", "moved"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "safe_ratio",
        "left": {
          "op": "count",
          "input": {
            "op": "where",
            "condition": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"},
            "input": {"op": "field", "name": "moved"}
          },
          "axis": "agent"
        },
        "right": {
          "op": "count",
          "input": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"},
          "axis": "agent"
        }
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "parameter_associations": [
        {
          "parameter": "move_probability",
          "relationship": "direct",
          "expected_indicator_direction": "increase",
          "rationale": "Higher move_probability increases the chance an unsatisfied agent attempts relocation, raising the proportion of unhappy agents that move."
        }
      ],
      "scientific_rationale": "This conditional relocation rate directly connects individual dissatisfaction events to subsequent relocation events."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_mean_move_distance",
      "semantic_name": "Mean periodic Manhattan relocation distance",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the mean move_distance across all agents, including zeros for non-movers.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "individual relocation events",
      "source_fields": ["move_distance"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "mean",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "move_distance"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Move distance is an event measure of relocation magnitude and is primitive at the individual relocation-event level."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_mean_destination_similarity_movers",
      "semantic_name": "Mean destination similarity among movers",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the average destination_similarity across agents that moved during the step; non-movers are excluded.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "agents that relocated",
      "source_fields": ["moved", "destination_similarity"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "mean",
        "input": {
          "op": "where",
          "condition": {"op": "field", "name": "moved"},
          "input": {"op": "field", "name": "destination_similarity"}
        },
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "parameter_associations": [
        {
          "parameter": "destination_preference",
          "relationship": "direct",
          "expected_indicator_direction": "increase",
          "rationale": "Higher destination_preference makes agents more likely to select the most similar sampled vacancy, raising average destination similarity among movers."
        }
      ],
      "scientific_rationale": "Destination similarity is an event measure only meaningful for relocation events; computing it conditional on moved captures the effect of destination choice."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_std_move_distance",
      "semantic_name": "Std of relocation distance",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the standard deviation across agents of move_distance, including zeros for non-movers.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "individual relocation events",
      "source_fields": ["move_distance"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "std",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "move_distance"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Variability in relocation distance is an individual-level event-measure observable that can reveal heterogeneous movement responses."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_corr_local_similarity_move_distance",
      "semantic_name": "Cross-agent correlation between local similarity and move distance",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the across-agent correlation between each agent's current local_similarity and move_distance within each recorded step.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "interaction",
      "entities": "individual agents' local context and movement",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity", "move_distance"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "correlation",
        "left": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
        "right": {"op": "field", "name": "move_distance"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Correlation between an individual's local similarity and its relocation distance is an interaction-level micro observable linking dissatisfaction context to movement behaviour."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_var_local_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Variance of local same-group similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the variance across agents of local same-group similarity.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "individual",
      "entities": "individual agents",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "variance",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Variance of the individual primitive local_similarity captures the spread of individual-level local contexts."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_mean_local_similarity_unhappy",
      "semantic_name": "Mean local similarity among unsatisfied agents",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the mean local_similarity across agents that are currently unhappy.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "elementary_event",
      "entities": "unsatisfied agents",
      "source_fields": ["unhappy", "local_similarity"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "mean",
        "input": {
          "op": "where",
          "condition": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"},
          "input": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"}
        },
        "axis": "agent"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Conditioning on the unhappy primitive isolates the local exposure of dissatisfied agents, a micro-level descriptor of dissatisfaction context."
    },
    {
      "id": "micro_frac_unhappy_boundary_agents",
      "semantic_name": "Fraction of boundary agents that are unhappy",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the fraction of boundary agents that are also unhappy.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "micro",
      "entity_scope": "interaction",
      "entities": "boundary agents with dissatisfaction",
      "source_fields": ["boundary_agent", "unhappy"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "safe_ratio",
        "left": {
          "op": "count",
          "input": {
            "op": "where",
            "condition": {"op": "field", "name": "boundary_agent"},
            "input": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"}
          },
          "axis": "agent"
        },
        "right": {
          "op": "count",
          "input": {"op": "field", "name": "boundary_agent"},
          "axis": "agent"
        }
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Combining boundary exposure with dissatisfaction captures an interaction-level micro observable linking local group contact to individual discontent."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_std_district_local_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Between-district variation in local similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the standard deviation across districts of district-level mean local same-group similarity.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "std",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "mean"
        },
        "axis": "group"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Disparities across fixed public districts in mean local similarity are genuine meso-level segregation structure."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_binned_entropy_district_local_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Binned entropy of district mean local similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the binned entropy across fixed public districts of district-level mean local same-group similarity.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "binned_entropy",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "mean"
        },
        "axis": "group",
        "bins": 5
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "The binned entropy of district means captures the diversity of local similarity regimes across fixed public spatial districts without collapsing them to a simple average."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_std_district_unhappy_frac",
      "semantic_name": "Between-district variation in unhappy fraction",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the standard deviation across districts of district-level fraction of unsatisfied agents.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["unhappy", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "std",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "fraction"
        },
        "axis": "group"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Between-district variation in dissatisfaction is a meso-level indicator of uneven local social tension."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_entropy_district_unhappy_frac",
      "semantic_name": "Entropy of district unhappy fractions",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the entropy across fixed public districts of district-level fraction of unsatisfied agents.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["unhappy", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "entropy",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "unhappy"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "fraction"
        },
        "axis": "group"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Entropy across district unhappy fractions measures how variously dissatisfaction is distributed across fixed public spatial districts."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_std_district_moved_frac",
      "semantic_name": "Between-district variation in relocation fraction",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the standard deviation across districts of district-level fraction of agents that relocated.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["moved", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "std",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "moved"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "fraction"
        },
        "axis": "group"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Differences in relocation activity across fixed districts expose local-domain heterogeneity in movement pressure."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_quantile_district_moved_frac",
      "semantic_name": "Upper quantile of district relocation fractions",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the 75th percentile across fixed public districts of district-level fraction of agents that relocated.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["moved", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "quantile",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "moved"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "fraction"
        },
        "axis": "group",
        "q": 0.75
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "The upper quantile of district relocation rates identifies local domains with elevated movement activity without reducing across districts to a simple mean."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_std_district_destination_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Between-district variation in mean destination similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the standard deviation across districts of district-level mean destination similarity among agents, including non-movers.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["destination_similarity", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "std",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "destination_similarity"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "mean"
        },
        "axis": "group"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Between-district variation in destination exposure captures local-domain heterogeneity in relocation outcomes."
    },
    {
      "id": "meso_entropy_district_boundary_frac",
      "semantic_name": "Entropy of district boundary agent fractions",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the entropy across fixed public districts of district-level fraction of boundary agents.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "meso",
      "entity_scope": "district",
      "entities": "fixed spatial districts",
      "source_fields": ["boundary_agent", "district_id"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "entropy",
        "input": {
          "op": "group_reduce",
          "values": {"op": "field", "name": "boundary_agent"},
          "groups": {"op": "field", "name": "district_id"},
          "axis": "agent",
          "reducer": "fraction"
        },
        "axis": "group"
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "Entropy across district boundary fractions captures how uniformly intergroup contact is spread across fixed public spatial districts."
    },
    {
      "id": "macro_mean_local_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Whole-system mean local similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the whole-system average across all agents of local same-group similarity, clipped to its valid range.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "macro",
      "entity_scope": "whole_system",
      "entities": "all agents as a system",
      "source_fields": ["local_similarity"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "clip",
        "input": {
          "op": "mean",
          "input": {"op": "field", "name": "local_similarity"},
          "axis": "agent"
        },
        "minimum": 0.0,
        "maximum": 1.0
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "A whole-system collective average of local exposure over all individuals represents the system-wide segregation tendency."
    },
    {
      "id": "macro_spatial_neighbor_similarity",
      "semantic_name": "Whole-grid spatial neighbor similarity",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the average same-group similarity between neighbouring occupied cells computed directly from the occupancy grid.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "macro",
      "entity_scope": "whole_system",
      "entities": "periodic grid system",
      "source_fields": ["state_grid"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "spatial_neighbor_similarity",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "state_grid"}
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "This global spatial structure operator summarises same-group clustering across the entire grid as a whole-system segregation outcome."
    },
    {
      "id": "macro_largest_component_fraction",
      "semantic_name": "Largest same-group component fraction",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the fraction of occupied cells belonging to the largest connected component of same-group agents.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "macro",
      "entity_scope": "whole_system",
      "entities": "grid connectivity system",
      "source_fields": ["state_grid"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "largest_component_fraction",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "state_grid"}
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "The dominance of the largest contiguous same-group region is a collective segregation outcome measurable only at the whole-system level."
    },
    {
      "id": "macro_connected_component_count",
      "semantic_name": "Count of same-group connected components",
      "scientific_definition": "Time series of the number of connected components of occupied cells with the same group label.",
      "phenomenon": "segregation",
      "scale": "macro",
      "entity_scope": "whole_system",
      "entities": "grid connectivity system",
      "source_fields": ["state_grid"],
      "computation": {
        "op": "connected_component_count",
        "input": {"op": "field", "name": "state_grid"}
      },
      "temporal_aggregation": {"op": "identity", "window": null},
      "scientific_rationale": "A global structural count of spatially separated same-group clusters captures whole-system fragmentation."
    }
  ],
  "interpretation_boundary": "Indicators are observational descriptors computed from the provided raw logs; they do not infer causal effects, support intervention claims, or draw prospective conclusions without simulation outcome evidence. Temporal aggregation is restricted to recorded-step summaries, so the indicators cannot establish temporal precedence or causal direction."
}
